sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 49 grams of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 20.7 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling. Omega 3 is 100 milligrams, weak for omega-3 fat support, and for seeds, fat quality has to justify the calories. For seeds, the fat profile is one of the biggest reasons they earn their place.

sections.title: Carbs

closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, magnesium, and often brings dense micronutrient support, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low fibre, and low omega 3. It is good for bone health, immune support, and muscles and strength sports because magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and the protein section supports repair and maintenance.
